parsed.why: National seat: hostile federal document, facility and custody regime applies, plus national-attached ban and protest arrests; local low-risk fragile, no visitor protections documented.

Strong local public-accommodation, hate-crime, shield-law and gender-neutral facilities protections materially reduce local outing consequences, but national passport, federal facility and custody exposures remain.
Local nondiscrimination, hate-crime and marker flexibility protect visitors, yet school/athletics restrictions and absent health-shield leave less durable protection than most-protective state.

Adult bathroom ban in government buildings/schools, complaint form inviting targeting, documentary defense unavailable to visitors, no public-accommodation protection and state custody harm compound national risk.
Campus bathroom restriction, prison treatment freeze, sports ban and no state hate-crime lower protection; court relief and municipal safeguards only partly offset harsher national framework.
